To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The key to the success of school leadership is the development of the values of the leader.

(a) successful school leaders are those who are able to balance and manage the multiple demands of their roles and (b) they do this by developing the capacity of others, by being clear about their own values and by being able to communicate these values effectively.

(a) the values of successful school leaders are similar to those of the general population, and (b) successful school leaders are more likely than the general population to have a value that is not shared by others.
